comments.text: Starting test-first implementation. Scope is limited to Ruby parser exclusions, YAML-backed Ruby topology rules, the shared pattern engine hook, and Ruby analyzer unit tests; manifest pipelines, eval gates, annotations, project files, and other repositories remain out of scope.

comments.author: os
comments.text: Implemented the Ruby detector/topology rules test-first. ActiveRecord models and concerns no longer emit database components; ordinary services no longer emit auth/service components; root-level exclusions now cover spec, test, vendor, and db/migrate; Rails route DSL, concrete auth integrations, and Net::HTTP/HTTParty/Faraday/RestClient evidence are covered. Verification: 21 focused Jest tests passed, TypeScript build passed, focused ESLint passed, and scoped git diff checks passed. The task remains in progress until the change lands.

comments.author: os
comments.text: Implementation complete pending landing: Rails models/concerns/services no longer emit components; routes collapse to one section API; concrete auth mechanisms compact by strategy; actor path+content rules now require both; ungrounded HTTP clients no longer create nodes; diagram mapping suppresses self-loop lineage. Added ruby-basic regression and verified gathersight at 10 components/7 edges/0 self-loops.
